description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LeaveRequestDaoTest' for testing the data access object (DAO) methods related to leave requests in an OrangeHRM plugin. It includes various test methods for retrieving, saving, and updating leave requests, entitlements, and related entities, as well as handling overlapping leave periods and entitlement adjustments.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the LeaveRequestDao functionalities, including retrieval, saving, entitlement management, overlapping leave detection, and status updates within the OrangeHRM leave plugin.
